answer: The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, released only after three unrelated confirmations, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Each submission hangs on the whisper of a task receipt, and the glacier is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The velvet of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
